detail.title: Senior Manager, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering
detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

 

BeOne is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative drug therapies for the treatment of cancer. At BeOne we believe that access to life-changing medicine sees no borders.


The Senior Manager, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering is a hands-on technical delivery role within the Systems Engineering capability area, reporting to the Senior Director, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering. This role is responsible for executing assigned systems engineering activities across R&D systems, externally developed platforms, integrations, and foundational ML, AI, genAI patterns.


The role translates defined technical standards, architecture direction, implementation plans, and operational expectations into reliable delivery across assigned systems and workstreams. The Senior Manager partners with Global Technology Solutions (Enterprise IT), vendors, R&D stakeholders, and GRDTS peers to ensure solutions align with enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity management, cloud, operational, and compliance standards.


The Senior Manager contributes practical systems engineering expertise across hybrid cloud, SaaS, high-performance computing (HPC), containerized environments, data pipeline integration, platform observability, and emerging AI architecture patterns including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), secure AI gateway patterns, agentic workflow orchestration, and multi-modal integration patterns. The role focuses on delivery quality, documentation, issue resolution, operational readiness, and sustained technical supportability.


A successful candidate brings strong technical execution skills, pharmaceutical / biotechnology domain awareness, disciplined delivery practices, and the ability to coordinate day-to-day work across business, vendor, Enterprise IT, and technical contributors. The Senior Manager is expected to raise risks and dependencies early, provide transparent execution updates, and help ensure assigned systems engineering work is scalable, secure, compliant, and fit for R&D scientific and business use.


As ours is a growing team, candidates may be evaluated for other suitable levels.

 

Essential Functions of the job:

Enterprise IT Alignment & Collaboration

• Execute assigned tasks within the Enterprise IT engagement model, coordinating with Global Technology Solutions to align R&D solutions with infrastructure, cybersecurity, identity management, cloud platform, and operational standards.

• Support technical design reviews, implementation dependency tracking, access / environment coordination, and issue resolution with Enterprise IT, vendors, and R&D stakeholders.

• Document specialized R&D technical needs, constraints, risks, and exceptions for review by the Associate Director and Senior Director.

Platforms & Systems Engineering

• Manage assigned systems engineering activities across on-premises, hybrid cloud, vendor-hosted, and multi-tenant SaaS environments, applying standards established for the Systems Engineering capability area.

• Develop and maintain technical documentation, integration designs, deployment plans, environment details, runbooks, and platform lifecycle artifacts for assigned systems or workstreams.

• Coordinate secure data, digital, and technology integration activities that connect third-party platforms, internal systems, and scientific data flows across defined R&D processes.

• Implement observability, telemetry, monitoring, alerting, and supportability practices for assigned systems to improve reliability, performance, and operational readiness.

• Support configuration, deployment, validation readiness, and operational handoff activities for high-performance computing clusters, containerized environments, storage layers, data lakes, and pipelines supporting compute-heavy R&D use cases.

• Track and execute technical lifecycle activities for assigned systems, including patch coordination, release preparation, codebase / configuration documentation, automated deployment inputs, and transition to steady-state support.

Foundational AI Architectures & Workflow Patterns

• Implement assigned components of RAG architectures, vector store integrations, semantic retrieval layers, chunking strategies, and AI-enabled systems under the direction of the Associate Director and Senior Director.

• Support reusable implementation patterns for agentic AI workflows, secure AI gateway integrations, multi-agent orchestration, and integration controls consistent with enterprise security and intellectual property protections.

• Assist in engineering integration patterns that allow systems to ingest, process, and reason across diverse data types and multi-modal inputs and outputs while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance expectations.

Change Management & Digital Adoption

• Execute technical change activities for assigned infrastructure modernization, cloud migration, integration, and platform adoption workstreams in collaboration with Global Technology Solutions and R&D stakeholders.

• Prepare and maintain technical impact assessments, adoption inputs, cutover checklists, support handoff materials, and release readiness documentation for leadership review.

• Help teams apply consistent integration standards, system documentation practices, and operational readiness expectations across assigned technology workstreams.

Governance & Risk Mitigation

• Apply architecture, security, compliance, and operational controls for assigned systems, including data protection expectations, secure AI gateway patterns, sandboxing requirements, and vendor risk inputs.

• Identify, document, and escalate technical risks, architectural constraints, support gaps, compliance considerations, and execution dependencies to the Associate Director and Senior Director.

• Coordinate with audit, compliance, CSV, cybersecurity, Enterprise IT, and vendor partners to support applicable pharmaceutical industry, GxP, computer systems validation, and internal policy requirements.

Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:

• Maintain disciplined use of engineering documentation, technical decision records, risk logs, implementation checklists, support artifacts, and operational handoff materials for assigned work.

• Ensure assigned systems and platforms are implemented and operated in line with relevant pharmaceutical regulations, internal policies, security standards, and validation expectations.

Collaboration & Partnership:

• Collaborate with R&D functional teams, Enterprise IT, vendors, and GRDTS peers to execute workstream objectives and improve delivery quality.

• Provide clear status, issue, dependency, and decision updates to the Associate Director and Senior Director to support transparency and timely leadership action.

 

Supervisory Alignment:

• Reports to the Senior Director, Global Digital & Technology Systems Engineering; works in close coordination with the Associate Director on assigned workstream priorities, standards, and execution expectations.

• No direct line-management responsibilities are required for this role. Provides day-to-day technical coordination for assigned systems engineering workstreams, project contributors, vendor resources, and matrixed technical teams.

• Coaches team members and partners on systems engineering practices, technical documentation, integration standards, observability, operational readiness, and compliance expectations.


Key Capabilities :

• Enterprise-to-R&D Infrastructure Execution: Applying Enterprise IT standards to assigned R&D platform designs and escalating specialized research requirements, risks, and exceptions through the Associate Director and Senior Director.

• External Platform Technical Assessment: Supporting technical assessment of vendor and externally developed platforms for scalability, security, architecture quality, integration readiness, supportability, and alignment with Enterprise standards.

• Internal & Vendor Platform Integration: Coordinating secure and maintainable integration activities that connect internal applications, scientific workflows, data pipelines, and third-party platforms.

• Full-Ecosystem Observability & Reliability: Implementing monitoring, telemetry, alert routing, runbooks, and support readiness practices for assigned internal and vendor-hosted applications.

• Advanced Compute & AI Architecture Implementation: Supporting implementation of cloud, high-performance computing, RAG pipeline, secure AI gateway, and agentic workflow patterns within approved architecture direction.

• Technical Governance & Execution Discipline: Applying unified architecture standards and maintaining reusable documentation, templates, and engineering artifacts for assigned systems and workstreams.

Key Competencies :

• Objective Technical Analysis: Reviews architecture diagrams, APIs, integration patterns, operational models, and vendor materials to identify technical readiness, risk, and delivery implications.

• Enterprise & Domain Collaboration: Works effectively with Enterprise IT and R&D stakeholders, balancing enterprise constraints with scientific and operational needs.

• Ecosystem-Level System Thinking: Understands internal applications, vendor platforms, data pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and AI patterns as connected parts of a broader R&D technology ecosystem.

• Enterprise Risk & IP Stewardship: Maintains appropriate attention to data protection, proprietary information, intellectual property, security, and regulated system expectations.

• Execution-Oriented Change Leadership: Helps teams move through technical change, adoption, documentation, and operational readiness while reinforcing standards and accountability.

• Resilient Issue Management: Provides structured technical coordination during upgrades, integration issues, infrastructure changes, and production incidents, with timely escalation as needed.

Key Deliverables :

• Assigned Workstream Technical Plans: Implementation plans, dependencies, environment details, risks, and architecture documentation for assigned systems engineering activities.

• Vendor Technical Assessment Inputs: Technical review notes, integration feasibility inputs, risk observations, and security / supportability inputs for proposed third-party solutions.

• Reusable Engineering Artifacts: Technical documentation, reference materials, configuration notes, implementation checklists, and templates for integration, AI, observability, and operational readiness patterns.

• Observability & Operational Readiness Materials: Monitoring requirements, telemetry specifications, runbooks, alerting inputs, support handoff materials, and readiness checklists for assigned platforms.

• Governance, Compliance & Technical Alignment Inputs: Risk logs, validation inputs, compliance documentation, architecture review materials, and Enterprise IT alignment inputs prepared for review by the Associate Director and Senior Director.

 

Technical Qualifications:

• Hands-on programming experience with Python and SQL for automation, data pipeline integration, API testing, platform scripting, and technical troubleshooting.

• Working knowledge of JavaScript / TypeScript for web application integration, workflow automation, and lightweight front-end or API-driven solution delivery.

• Experience with scripting and automation using Bash, PowerShell, or equivalent tools for deployment support, environment configuration, log analysis, and operational runbooks.

• Familiarity with R for scientific, statistical, or analytics workflows is preferred; exposure to Java, C#, or similar enterprise application languages is a plus.

• Practical understanding of REST APIs, event-driven integration, JSON / XML data exchange, authentication patterns, and secure system-to-system connectivity.

• Experience with cloud and platform engineering practices across AWS and/or Azure, including compute, storage, networking, identity, access controls, monitoring, and cost-aware resource usage.

• Working knowledge of containers and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes, plus infrastructure-as-code or configuration automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or similar.

General Description:

  • The Director, Quality Systems will report to the Sr. Director, Quality Systems and Validation and serve as a Global Technology Solutions leader responsible for the technology operations, deployment, and lifecycle support of enterprise Quality Management System (QMS) platforms, Veeva Quality applications, other Quality Assurance systems, and related GxP applications.
  • This role will be primarily GTS-facing, with accountability for translating Quality business needs and QMS process requirements into technology execution plans, managing application operations, coordinating project delivery, overseeing vendors and managed service partners, and ensuring reliable, compliant, and scalable Quality technology solutions. The individual will work closely with Global Quality, site Quality, business process owners, and GTS functions to support the Quality Systems roadmap, manage budgets and forecasts, prioritize demand, and deliver system enhancements and projects.

The role must bring a strong understanding of the Quality and regulated GxP environment, including data integrity, change control, validation, and CSA expectations.


**NOTE: GTS (Global Technology Solutions) is the new name of our IT business unit**


Essential Functions of the job:

  • Lead GTS delivery, deployment, and operational support for enterprise QMS platforms and other Quality Assurance systems, with emphasis on Veeva Quality applications and related integrations.
  • Manage application operations across QMS and QA technology platforms, including incident and problem management, enhancement intake, configuration oversight, release coordination, service performance, operational metrics, user support, and lifecycle planning.
  • Experience leading enterprise QMS deployments, enhancements, application support, and project delivery for Quality Assurance systems in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or life sciences environment is required. Hands-on experience with Veeva Quality applications is required, including practical involvement in implementation, configuration review, release support, testing coordination, issue resolution, and operational support.
  • Translate Quality Assurance business requirements, QMS process needs, and compliance expectations into practical technology plans, Veeva configuration and enhancement approaches, delivery commitments, system changes, and support models in partnership with Quality stakeholders and GTS functions.
  • Strong GTS or IT delivery experience is required, including service management, vendor management, release coordination, budget management, demand management, roadmap support, and cross-functional technology delivery. Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11, data integrity expectations, GxP computer system validation, and Computer Software Assurance principles is required, with emphasis on applying approved procedures and maintaining validated systems rather than designing enterprise validation strategy.
  • Experience with Quality platforms such as Validation Management System (ValGenesis), Inspection Management, AI tools used in pharma, laboratory, manufacturing, training and/or other regulated Quality systems is preferred.
  • Manage delivery of Quality technology projects and initiatives, including scope, schedule, resources, budget, risks, dependencies, vendor performance, stakeholder communication, and operational readiness.
  • Provide hands-on leadership for Veeva Quality deployment activities, including requirements clarification, solution design input, configuration review, data and integration considerations, testing coordination, defect resolution, release readiness, and post-go-live stabilization.
  • Support deployment and enhancement of QA systems supporting document control, training, deviations, CAPA, change control, complaints, audits, quality risk management, supplier quality, inspection readiness, and related Quality processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across GTS, Quality, site stakeholders, Procurement, Finance, and vendors to deliver reliable, compliant, and business-aligned technology solutions.
  • Support creation, maintenance, and execution of the Quality Systems roadmap by partnering with Quality and GTS leadership to consolidate demand, assess technical feasibility, estimate effort and cost, sequence priorities, and convert roadmap items into executable delivery plans.
  • Manage department and project budgets, including supporting forecasting, annual planning input, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, vendor spend oversight, accrual support, and routine financial reporting to leadership.
  • Partner with GTS architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data, integration, service management, procurement, finance, and external vendors to deliver and support Quality technology solutions.
  • Ensure Quality systems remain in a validated and compliant state by following approved SOPs, change control, release management, validation, CSA, data integrity, access management, and system lifecycle procedures.
  • Coordinate and support validation and CSA deliverables for system changes and projects, including planning input, documentation coordination, testing evidence review, deviation support, release readiness, and operational handover.
  • Maintain strong working knowledge of Quality business processes, GxP expectations, inspection readiness, and regulated system operations to ensure technology decisions appropriately support the Quality organization.
  • Monitor technology service trends, compliance risks, project status, resource constraints, and vendor performance; escalate issues and recommend practical improvements to strengthen operational reliability and business value.
  • Provide clear communication to Quality and GTS leadership regarding project delivery, operational performance, roadmap progress, budget status, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions required.

detail.title: Associate Director, Medical Writer - HEOR Publications
detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description: 
We are seeking a highly experienced and strategically minded Medical Writer to lead the development and execution of global health economics and outcomes research (HEOR) publications across our oncology portfolio. This role will translate complex health economic, real-world evidence (RWE), patient-reported outcomes (PRO), healthcare resource utilization (HCRU), and outcomes research data into clear, scientifically rigorous, and high-impact publications and congress materials.


The Associate Director will partner with HEOR, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Evidence Generation, and external experts to ensure timely dissemination of evidence supporting the clinical, economic, and patient-centered value of BeOne Medicines therapies. The role will help shape the external scientific narrative and support evidence-based healthcare decision-making globally. 

This is an individual contributor, remote position.


Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Lead the development, writing, and execution of HEOR-focused scientific publications, including manuscripts, abstracts, posters, podium presentations, and congress materials.
  • Translate complex HEOR evidence, including cost-effectiveness analyses, budget impact models, RWE studies, PRO research, treatment-pattern analyses, comparative effectiveness research, and HCRU analyses, into scientifically rigorous and impactful communications.
  • Partner closely with HEOR, Market Access, Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Evidence Generation, and cross-functional product teams to support publication strategy and evidence-dissemination objectives.
  • Contribute to the development and execution of integrated publication plans that support global value demonstration, evidence generation, and access strategies.
  • Provide strategic leadership in developing evidence-dissemination plans aligned with global HEOR, market access, and product value communication objectives.
  • Collaborate with external authors, health economists, outcomes researchers, key opinion leaders, and publication steering committees to advance publication development and scientific engagement.
  • Critically interpret study designs, statistical analyses, observational research, economic models, and patient-centered outcomes data to ensure accurate and balanced communication.
  • Ensure publication activities comply with Good Publication Practice (GPP), ICMJE recommendations, applicable ISPOR Good Practices, and company policies and procedures.
  • Manage multiple concurrent publication projects across indications and geographic regions, ensuring delivery to agreed timelines, quality standards, and budgets.
  • Provide scientific and editorial direction to cross-functional teams, external vendors, and publication agencies.
  • Establish and maintain effective relationships with authors, journals, congress organizations, publishers, and professional societies.

At BeOne, our Global Development SuperHighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.


We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through SuperHighway partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.


The Clinical Development Lead is accountable for developing clinical program strategy and assuring that activities are executed within expected scope, budget, and timelines for our partnership programs under the Development SuperHighway. The Lead provides clinical development leadership and co-works with other core-team members to ensure successful delivery by the execution functions.
This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical SuperHighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Cross-Functional Team Membership

  • Participates in and/or leads the relevant Therapeutic Team (TT) and/or represents CD in Study Team relevant to assigned molecule(s)/indication(s) and helps ensure cross-functional integration, coordination and alignment to enable effective and efficient CD plan execution.
  • May also, as appropriate, support relevant Study Team in training new team members.

  • As appropriate, participates in competitive intelligence and/or other market/industry assessment activities and projects.

  • May participate in meetings, reviews, discussions and other interactions regarding early development/Phase I studies to provide clinical science input and guidance.
  • Responsible for creating and implementing the CD plan for assigned molecule(s)/indication(s) and/or other programs together with CST and other relevant teams.
  • Communicates with HAs, as and when needed, or otherwise appropriate. Ethically, effectively and professionally represents the interests of BeOne and patients.

Clinical Development Plan Implementation

  • Provides clinical oversight across all relevant studies and programs; leads and/or otherwise participates in ongoing TT and relevant study team meetings, other interactions and communications.
  • Designs and develops clinical studies; collaborates with others in the development of the product safety profile and clinical sections of investigator brochures, presentations and other materials.
  • May participate in the identification and selection of appropriate external investigators and sites.
  • Ensures investigators are appropriately and thoroughly briefed, in a timely manner, on medical/scientific matters relating to each study. Acts as a medical monitor for assigned studies.

  • Collaborates with relevant teams and other groups to measure and monitor study progress against objectives, proactively communicate any issues, challenges and potential strategies to resolve such.
  • Collaborates with other groups to ensure timely and appropriate completion of interim and final study reporting; accountable to ensure correct medical/scientific data interpretation for interim and final study reporting.
  • Plays a lead role in the development and implementation of communications strategies to support existing and concluded studies, including KOL interactions, advisory boards, major medical meetings, congresses and other events, publications and other materials.

detail.title: Senior Manager, Global R&D Audits & Inspections Readiness
detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

 

BeOne is a global biopharmaceutical company dedicated to the discovery and development of innovative drug therapies for the treatment of cancer. At BeOne we believe that access to life-changing medicine sees no borders.


General Description:

The Senior Manager, Global R&D Audits & Inspections Readiness is an execution-focused role responsible for helping maintain a continuous state of regulatory compliance and inspection readiness for R&D technology solutions. Reporting to the Senior Director, this role translates audit readiness strategy, validation-by-design principles, regulatory expectations, and quality standards into practical day-to-day execution across assigned systems, products, vendors, and readiness activities.

 

The role partners closely with software engineering, product owners, Quality, Compliance, Enterprise IT, Security, vendors, and R&D stakeholders to embed GxP compliance, computerized systems validation (CSV), Computer Software Assurance (CSA), and data integrity expectations into Agile / Scrum delivery, automated testing, CI/CD practices, system lifecycle documentation, and operational support activities.

 

Because there will be three Senior Manager roles within this capability area, each Senior Manager may be assigned a combination of execution focus areas to ensure full coverage across the capability. Potential focus-area combinations include product lifecycle validation and agile delivery readiness; audit / inspection coordination and SME preparation; externally sourced system, vendor, and SaaS compliance; regulatory intelligence translation; CAPA / remediation tracking; and compliance metrics / readiness dashboards.

 

A successful candidate brings practical GxP compliance, CSV / CSA, audit readiness, and technology delivery experience, with the ability to coordinate detailed execution across multiple stakeholders. The role requires strong documentation discipline, risk-based thinking, inspection composure, and the ability to translate regulatory and quality expectations into clear technical actions for engineering and product teams.

 

Essential Functions of the job:


In-House Product Validation & Lifecycle Integration

• Execute assigned validation-by-design activities with software engineering, product owners, and QA to embed GxP expectations into Agile / Scrum delivery practices.

• Coordinate the creation, review, and maintenance of validation deliverables such as User Requirement Specifications (URS), Functional Specifications (FS), risk assessments, test evidence, traceability matrices, and release readiness documentation during active delivery cycles.

• Support DevOps and engineering teams in aligning automated testing, CI/CD evidence, electronic records, and release controls with audit-ready verification expectations.

• Apply delta-based validation approaches for iterative feature updates, ensuring changes are evaluated, documented, tested, and released in line with risk-based standards.

• Help define and apply GxP Definition of Done criteria so software completion includes required technical specifications, evidence, controls, and compliance checkpoints.

Audit & Inspection Orchestration

• Lead assigned workstreams for internal audits, mock inspections, inspection readiness exercises, and external health authority inspection preparation.

• Prepare technical inspection storyboards, system narratives, architecture summaries, data flow explanations, evidence packages, and document retrieval plans for assigned systems or topics.

• Coach product owners, engineering SMEs, vendors, and support teams on audit protocols, interview preparation, response discipline, and precise regulatory communication.

• Support front-room and back-room operations during active audits or inspections, coordinating rapid evidence retrieval, response tracking, SME availability, and follow-up documentation.

Externally Sourced System Compliance & Platform Readiness

• Oversee assigned externally sourced R&D IT systems, platforms, vendors, or SaaS providers to help maintain continuous compliance and inspection readiness.

• Support vendor qualification, periodic review, compliance assessment, audit preparation, and review of third-party deliverables against internal GxP expectations.

• Coordinate CSV / CSA execution for vendor-hosted or externally developed systems, ensuring requirements, risk rationale, test evidence, traceability, and operational controls are complete and current.

Regulatory Intelligence & Interpretation

• Translate assigned regulatory and quality expectations, including FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP 5, ALCOA+, HIPAA, GDPR, and emerging AI/ML guidance, into practical engineering and system lifecycle actions.

• Support gap assessments against new or changing regulatory guidance and document recommended remediation or process improvement actions for leadership review.

• Partner with Quality, Compliance, Security, and Enterprise IT to align technical policies, SDLC checkpoints, and system controls with regulatory expectations.

Risk Management, Remediation & Quality Culture

• Manage assigned R&D systems-related CAPA, audit finding, remediation, or gap closure activities, ensuring actions are tracked, owners are aligned, and evidence is completed on time.

• Maintain compliance KPIs, inspection readiness trackers, risk logs, platform readiness views, and issue status updates for assigned systems or focus areas.

• Promote a quality-first mindset within engineering and product teams by balancing agile delivery speed with data integrity, validation, security, and regulatory requirements.


GRDTS Leadership:

Operational Excellence, Compliance & Governance:

• Apply standard ways of working for validation documentation, inspection readiness evidence, audit response tracking, CAPA execution, and system compliance reporting.

• Ensure assigned activities embed CSV, CSA, compliance, data integrity, privacy, security, and health authority expectations into day-to-day operational work.

Collaboration & Partnership:

• Collaborate with Enterprise IT, Quality, Security, vendors, software engineering, product owners, and R&D stakeholders to complete assigned audit readiness and compliance execution activities.

• Provide concise status, risk, dependency, and decision updates to the Senior Director to support prioritization, inspection readiness, and leadership visibility.

 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• No direct line-management responsibilities are required. Provides day-to-day execution leadership for assigned audit readiness, validation, vendor compliance, CAPA, readiness metrics, and inspection support workstreams.

• May coordinate matrixed contributors, vendors, SMEs, product owners, engineering resources, and quality partners during readiness exercises, documentation cycles, audit preparation, and remediation activities.

• Coaches stakeholders on validation-by-design practices, inspection communication, documentation quality, evidence readiness, and compliance execution expectations.


Assigned Focus Area Model for Senior Manager Roles :

• Senior Manager roles are expected to cover multiple execution focus areas rather than operate as isolated single-domain roles.

• Possible focus-area coverage may include: product lifecycle validation and CSA delivery; audit / inspection orchestration and SME readiness; externally sourced system / vendor compliance; regulatory intelligence and policy translation; CAPA / remediation execution; compliance KPIs and readiness dashboards.

• Specific focus areas may be assigned or adjusted based on R&D portfolio priorities, inspection calendar needs, system risk, vendor landscape, and capacity.


Key Capabilities :

• Agile Validation-by-Design Execution: Embedding GxP compliance tasks, evidence expectations, and validation artifacts into active sprint cycles and delivery workflows.

• Modernized Validation Execution (CSV to CSA): Applying risk-based CSA concepts to assigned systems, focusing testing and documentation on critical-to-quality elements while supporting accelerated, compliant releases.

• Audit & Inspection Readiness Execution: Coordinating inspection preparation, technical storyboards, evidence retrieval, SME coaching, and front-room / back-room support for assigned audits or systems.

• Technical Regulatory Translation: Converting regulatory expectations and quality requirements into practical SDLC checkpoints, system controls, definition-of-done criteria, and engineering actions.

• Quality Lifecycle Management & Remediation: Tracking CAPA, gap assessments, vendor findings, remediation actions, root-cause inputs, and readiness evidence through closure.

• Vendor & Externally Sourced System Compliance: Supporting assessment, periodic review, audit readiness, and compliance documentation for third-party platforms, SaaS providers, and external technology partners.


Key Competencies :

• Risk-Based Operational Mindset: Focuses effort on patient safety, product quality, data integrity, and critical system controls rather than documentation volume alone.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Works effectively across engineering, product, Quality, Compliance, Enterprise IT, Security, vendors, and R&D stakeholders.

• Inspection Discipline: Maintains composure and precision during audit preparation and live inspection support, with strong attention to evidence quality and response accuracy.

• Objective Third-Party Evaluation: Reviews vendor and SaaS documentation, system evidence, and compliance commitments against internal GxP standards and risk expectations.

• Proactive Continuous Quality Drive: Helps keep assigned systems, platforms, repositories, evidence, and readiness trackers in a state of ongoing inspection readiness.


Key Deliverables :

Product Life-Cycle & Validation Artifacts

• Validation Documentation Packages: URS, FS, risk assessments, testing evidence, traceability matrices, release readiness evidence, and lifecycle documentation for assigned systems or releases.

• Delta Validation & CSA Execution Materials: Risk-based validation plans, change impact assessments, automated evidence expectations, CI/CD control evidence, and CSA rationale for iterative releases.

• GxP Definition of Done Inputs: Practical engineering completion criteria, compliance checkpoints, and evidence expectations for assigned products or delivery teams.

Inspection Readiness & Defense

• Technical Inspection Storyboards: System narratives, architecture overviews, data flow summaries, control explanations, and evidence maps for assigned systems or topics.

• SME Audit Preparation Materials: Training notes, mock interview scripts, response guidance, document retrieval checklists, and communication protocols for product owners and engineering SMEs.

Risk, Governance & Quality Metrics

• CAPA / Finding Execution Files: Root-cause inputs, action plans, evidence packages, status trackers, and closure documentation for assigned system or process gaps.

• Vendor & SaaS GxP Assessment Inputs: Compliance assessment notes, evidence reviews, gap findings, risk ratings, and readiness recommendations for third-party systems.

• Compliance KPI & Readiness Reporting: Assigned readiness metrics, dashboard inputs, risk registers, gap trackers, and leadership status updates.


Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Bioengineering, Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory, or a related field. An advanced degree is a plus.

• 7+ years of experience in IT compliance, quality assurance, software engineering, systems validation, audit readiness, or related technology quality roles within the pharmaceutical, biotech, or medical device industry.

• 3+ years of experience supporting audit / inspection readiness activities, mock audits, regulatory inspections, vendor audits, validation programs, CAPA execution, or compliance remediation.

• Practical experience embedding GxP compliance into Agile / Scrum delivery, system lifecycle practices, validation documentation, test evidence management, and/or DevOps / CI/CD workflows.


Technical & Regulatory Knowledge

• Strong working knowledge of FDA 21 CFR Part 11, EMA Annex 11, GAMP 5 principles, CSV, CSA, data integrity expectations such as ALCOA+, and relevant privacy / security considerations such as HIPAA and GDPR.

• Ability to apply risk-based testing, delta validation, change impact assessment, requirements traceability, evidence review, vendor compliance assessment, and inspection readiness practices.

• Familiarity with modern software delivery, cloud / SaaS platforms, externally sourced systems, AI/ML technology considerations, and regulated R&D data environments.


Preferred Certifications (Possession of one or more is desirable)

• Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), or equivalent quality / audit certification.

• Agile / Scrum certification such as Certified ScrumMaster or Product Owner, indicating understanding of modern software delivery workflows.

 

Other Qualifications:

• Business relationship management acumen and ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders in quality, technology, security, vendor, and R&D environments.

• Strong documentation, communication, facilitation, issue management, and follow-through skills, with the ability to translate complex regulatory expectations into practical execution tasks.

• Comfortable working with a broad cross-section of people in direct, matrixed, vendor, and inspection support relationships.

• Proficient in project and delivery practices such as Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Lean, release readiness, audit preparation, and remediation tracking.


Travel:

The Director, Strategic Evidence, will possess an understanding of US market access priorities, evidence generation, and proficiency in AI technologies. As a key member of our team, you will leverage your knowledge of market access dynamics, evidence needs and research methodologies to develop and drive evidence streams that are strategic, customer focused and optimize patient care decision-making processes.

Market Access Strategy Development:

  • Collaborate with matrix stakeholders in working with key stakeholders, addressing segment needs, and planning for market trends influencing patient access for new and existing products.

detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Director, Legal Entity Planning & Forecasting will be a key member of the Corporate FP&A team and will own the enterprise legal entity forecasting and reporting framework. The role will translate the management forecast into a complete, accurate, and reconciled legal entity forecast. This serves as a key input to our corporate tax planning and transfer pricing processes, legal entity cash flow and liquidity forecasting, as well as other related accounting analyses. The position will partner with Corporate FP&A, Global Tax, Treasury, Accounting/Controllership, Finance Systems, and business finance teams across Commercial, R&D, Technical Operations, and G&A.

The successful candidate will combine strong FP&A and business planning capabilities with sufficient accounting, tax, intercompany, and legal entity knowledge to understand how management forecasts translate into legal entity financial statements and related implications on tax planning, transfer pricing, and capital allocation strategies (cash flow by entity perspective). This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for building governance, controls, and accountability around legal entity forecasting while ensuring one reconciled view of the company across management and statutory/tax needs.

The ideal candidate is proactive, highly analytical, comfortable operating in a dynamic global environment, and able to move between detailed model mechanics and executive-level insights. The role requires strong cross-functional influence, process design skills, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish and govern the enterprise Legal Entity Forecasting framework, including process design, calendar, ownership, controls, data requirements, and reconciliation to the management forecast

  • Lead the translation of management forecasts into legal entity forecasts, ensuring entity-level P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow projections reconcile to the consolidated FP&A outlook

  • Partner with Finance Systems/TM1 to design scalable forecasting capabilities, enabling efficient capture and allocation of costs, intercompany activity, and other legal entity drivers across the enterprise

  • Provide reliable legal entity forecasts and insights to Global Tax to support tax provision, effective tax rate forecasting, tax planning, transfer pricing, impairment/valuation analysis, and other accounting-for-income-tax requirements

  • Partner with Treasury to assess legal entity liquidity and cash generation, identifying potential funding requirements, trapped cash, and implications for capital allocation and treasury risk

  • Perform regular actual-to-forecast and forecast-to-forecast variance analysis by legal entity, identifying key drivers, emerging risks, and potential implications for Global Tax, Treasury, Accounting, and management reporting

  • Establish governance and accountability across Legal Entity Finance Directors and functional teams, ensuring completeness, accuracy, timely submissions, and resolution of forecast risks

  • Provide management with actionable legal entity insights, highlighting forecast changes and emerging risks impacting GlobalTax, Treasury, Accounting, and enterprise financial planning.

Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience across FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, controllership, transaction advisory, audit, or related finance disciplines in a complex multinational environment.

  • CPA preferred. Big 4 audit, accounting advisory, transaction services, or similar background is highly valued but not required if equivalent corporate experience is demonstrated.

  • Demonstrated experience with legal entity forecasting statutory/entity-level planning, tax forecasting support, or integrated forecasting across FP&A, Global Tax, Treasury, and Accounting.

  • Strong understanding of US GAAP and consolidated financial statements; IFRS knowledge; knowledge of accounting for income taxes (ASC 740), impairment/valuation concepts, and the role of forecasts in external reporting.

  • Solid understanding of intercompany transactions, transfer pricing, and how operational activity flows through legal entities.

  • Experience with cash flow and liquidity forecasting and the ability to connect legal entity earnings, balance sheet movements, and cash requirements.

  • Experience in the pharmaceutical/biotechnology industry strongly preferred, with understanding of R&D, Technical Operations/manufacturing, Commercial, and Global Medical Affairs economics.

  • Public-company and multinational experience strongly preferred; SEC reporting exposure is a plus.

  • Advanced financial modeling and systems skills; TM1/Planning Analytics experience strongly preferred, with advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.

  • People-management experience and demonstrated ability to influence across functions without direct authority.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex entity-level financial information into clear executive insights.

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, results-focused, and comfortable balancing strategic process design with hands-on execution.

detail.jobDescription:

General Description:

The Senior Director, Microsoft 365 Platforms & Strategy is accountable for the strategy, roadmap, engineering, governance, lifecycle, reliability, and employee experience of BeOne’s global Microsoft 365 environment. Success is measured against agreed performance measures, baselines, objectives, and targets aligned with BeOne’s enterprise technology, security, data, architecture, and financial strategies.

The portfolio includes Microsoft 365 Apps, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and related services. This leader establishes clear product and platform ownership, strengthens internal engineering capability, and ensures the environment is secure, reliable, supportable, and positioned to enable employee productivity.

The position also provides Microsoft 365 leadership for BeOne’s global domain migration, continued platform modernization, and AI-enabled productivity capabilities within a global, matrixed organization.

Essential Functions of the Role:

  • Platform Strategy & Product Ownership: Own the global Microsoft 365 strategy, roadmap, priorities, lifecycle, investment recommendations, product-management model, demand intake, and intentional introduction of new capabilities. Establish appropriate performance measures and baselines, secure agreement on targets, and be accountable for delivery against approved targets.
  • Architecture, Engineering & Platform Reliability: Lead tenant architecture, engineering standards, configuration, automation, resilience, technical-debt management, service health, operational readiness, and the resolution of major platform escalations.
  • Service Delivery & Enterprise Technology Guidance: Partner closely with Service Delivery and Tier 1 support teams to establish effective operating and support models, escalation paths, service performance management, and continuous improvement across the Microsoft 365 stack. Provide authoritative, enterprise-minded guidance on when Microsoft 365 is the appropriate solution and when alternative BeOne enterprise platforms or solutions should be considered.
  • Governance, Security & Compliance Execution: Partner with Cyber Security, Privacy, Information Governance, Quality, Legal, Compliance, Identity, and Enterprise Architecture to translate established enterprise requirements into Microsoft 365 controls and operating practices, including information protection, retention, auditing, access, collaboration, and lifecycle controls. Escalate unresolved requirements, risks, or ownership conflicts to the appropriate enterprise function.
  • Data, Analytics & Enterprise Integration: Establish Microsoft 365 as a well-governed component of BeOne’s broader enterprise integration and data ecosystem. Partner with Data & Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and other technology teams on integrations using Microsoft Graph APIs and related Microsoft 365 services, providing platform expertise, architectural guidance, governance, and lifecycle oversight to enable secure, scalable, and supportable enterprise solutions.
  • Transformation & Modernization: Lead the Microsoft 365 components of major enterprise transformations, including BeOne's global domain migration, tenant and platform modernization, and major collaboration changes, with disciplined readiness, transition, and service continuity.
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot Enablement: Own platform readiness, configuration, licensing, utilization reporting, service health, and technical enablement for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Partner with Enterprise AI, business leaders, and change and adoption teams on responsible adoption, use-case priorities, and value measurement.
  • Microsoft, Partner & Commercial Management: Lead the Microsoft 365 relationship and key partner governance, partnering with Procurement and enterprise technology leadership on licensing strategy, utilization optimization, investment recommendations, commercial evaluation, partner performance, and total cost of ownership.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Lead a globally distributed team and strategic partner resources supporting Microsoft 365 platforms and services.
  • Establish clear accountability and decision rights across product and platform ownership, engineering, governance, and operations.
  • Develop technical and leadership capability through coaching, performance management, succession planning, and talent development.
  • Build strong partnerships across regions and functions while driving enterprise standards and consistent global ways of working.

Qualifications:

  • BS Degree with 12+ years of progressive enterprise technology experience across Microsoft technologies, digital workplace, enterprise platforms, or related functions, including leadership of global teams and accountability for an enterprise-scale Microsoft 365 environment.
  • Demonstrated success establishing or improving product and platform ownership, governance, engineering, service-management, and support practices for Microsoft 365 in a complex global organization.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 architecture and services, with sufficient technical depth to direct platform strategy, architecture, engineering, operational decisions, and Microsoft Graph API-enabled integrations at enterprise scale.
  • Demonstrated enterprise technology judgment, including the ability to evaluate business needs objectively and recommend Microsoft 365 or alternative enterprise platforms based on fit, security, scalability, supportability, integration, and total cost of ownership.
  • Experience partnering with Service Delivery, Tier 1 support, Data & Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, and Security teams to establish operating models and deliver secure, governed, lifecycle-managed enterprise integrations.
  • Experience leading major platform modernization, domain or tenant migrations, and complex enterprise change while maintaining reliable global service delivery.
  • Sound commercial and financial judgment, including experience with Microsoft licensing, utilization optimization, vendor governance, investment planning, and total-cost-of-ownership management.
  • Proven ability to lead and influence global teams, senior stakeholders, business functions, and technology organizations, with strong executive communication and decision-making skills.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, life sciences, healthcare, or another highly regulated global environment is strongly preferred.

Travel:

detail.jobDescription:

General Description:

As Senior Director, Organizational Change Management (OCM), you will lead GTS’s enterprise OCM strategy in support of the BeOne’s mission: helping BeOne build the next-generation global oncology company and expand access to high-quality cancer therapies worldwide. By proactively orchestrating organizational change, you will enable colleagues, customers, and patients to adopt intuitive experiences, scalable services, and capabilities delivered through a unified technology ecosystem.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Operational Strategy & Enablement, you will serve as GTS’s change architect and strategic advisor to executives and transformation sponsors. You will architect and orchestrate change across multiple regions, cultures, time zones, governance structures, and decision-making models, aligning diverse stakeholders around shared outcomes while adapting delivery approaches to local needs. You will shape strategy, portfolio sequencing, sponsorship, governance, and risk mitigation across GBS, ServiceNow, ERP, AI adoption, and operating model redesign, ensuring changes strengthen secure systems, compliant processes, trusted data, and AI-enabled intelligent automation.

You will scale a global OCM center of excellence and practitioner network, establishing methodologies, capabilities, and performance measures that accelerate adoption, organizational readiness, and measurable value. Through coaching and partnerships with the Global Technology Solutions Leadership Team (GTS-LT), Program and Portfolio Governance (PPG), Process and Service Excellence (PSE), Human Resources (HR), Corporate Communications, and business leaders, you will embed change leadership and the North Star outcomes into transformation delivery.

Essential Functions of the Job:

  • Enterprise OCM Strategy & Governance: Define the GTS OCM vision, operating model, standards, and roadmap aligned with the North Star. Establish portfolio change criteria, assurance practices, and escalation mechanisms that strengthen adoption, value realization, security, compliance, and organizational readiness.
  • Advisory & Sponsorship: Advise GTS leaders and sponsors on organizational impacts, stakeholder risks, alignment, and interventions. Coach leaders to visibly sponsor change and reinforce accountability.
  • Transformation Portfolio Leadership: Oversee OCM across GBS, ServiceNow, ERP, AI, and operating model transformations. Integrate change requirements into portfolio planning, investments, governance, and the GTS Software Delivery Lifecycle to advance a unified technology ecosystem and scalable global capabilities.
  • GBS & Operating Model Transformation: Partner with process owners and GBS leaders on transition strategies, workforce readiness, service adoption, and regional process standardization. Enable scalable services and intuitive experiences for BeOne colleagues while sustaining secure, compliant operations.
  • OCM Center of Excellence: Lead a scalable global OCM capability encompassing methodologies, toolkits, quality standards, practitioner development, communities of practice, and champion networks.
  • Adoption, Readiness & Value Realization: Establish measures for readiness, adoption, proficiency, user experience, and benefits realization. Apply trusted data, stakeholder feedback, and corrective actions to improve outcomes for colleagues, customers, and patients.
  • Leadership Communications & Engagement: Shape transformation narratives and executive communications with Communications and business leaders. Oversee engagement for town halls, leadership forums, and GTS events.
  • Talent & Team Leadership: Recruit, develop, and lead a global OCM team. Set objectives, allocate resources, manage partners, and build succession plans.
  • North Star & OKRs: Translate the GTS North Star into actionable OCM priorities, outcomes, and OKRs. Strengthen accountability for intuitive user experiences, scalable services, unified technology, secure and compliant processes, trusted data, intelligent automation, and expanded access to cancer therapies.

Location:

  • Preference for East Coast Location.

  • Lead a global OCM team, accountable for organization design, talent, performance, resources, succession, and external partners.

Required Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Organizational Development, Business, Communications, Human Resources, Psychology, Engineering, or a related field required; a relevant Master’s degree is strongly preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree or a Master’s degree (strongly preferred) in a related discipline with 12 + years of experience supporting enterprise transformation leadership.
  • Change Management Certification: Prosci, Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP), or an equivalent advanced credential demonstrating recognized OCM expertise is strongly preferred.
  • Transformation Credentials: Project Management Professional, Agile, Lean, or comparable certification supporting disciplined transformation planning, execution, and continuous improvement is preferred.
  • AI & Digital Fluency: Demonstrates knowledge of enterprise artificial intelligence, digital adoption, intelligent automation, and technology-enabled change practices within complex organizations.
  • Enterprise Leadership: 12+ years in organizational change, transformation, organizational development, or consulting, including 5+ years leading global teams or OCM functions.
  • Large-Scale Transformation: Demonstrates success leading complex, multi-year transformations spanning technology, processes, operating models, workforce capabilities, organizational structures, and culture.
  • Global & GBS Experience: Architects and orchestrates change across the Americas, Europe, and APAC, navigating cultural differences, regional contexts, and varied decision-making models.

detail.title: Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) Fellow
detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

** When applying, please upload your curriculum vitae (CV), letter of intent, and unofficial college transcript in PDF format under the "CV/Resume" section of the application.

Education Required:  

Candidate should have completed a Doctor of Pharmacy (PharmD), Master’s in Regulatory Affairs, or a Ph.D. in life sciences by July 2027. 

General Description:  

The BeOne Medicines Global Regulatory Affairs (GRA) Fellow will engage in a one-year rotational program that includes working in various departments within GRA to support BeOne regulatory drug development in Global Regulatory Policy and Intelligence (GRPI), Regulatory Strategy, Advertising and Promotion, and Labeling. The Fellow will apply their scientific knowledge, regulatory learnings and independent judgment to support and execute key deliverables for each sub-function. These key deliverables, presentations and projects inform important regulatory strategy.  Effective communication, both written and verbal, and critical thinking are vital skills for this role. The fellowship will be conducted remotely beginning July 2027. 

 

Essential Functions of the job:  

The GRA Fellow will rotate throughout the Global Regulatory Affairs Department in the four below sub-departments and perform the tasks identified below under the supervision of each respective sub-department: 

Global Regulatory Policy and Intelligence (GRPI) 

  • The GRPI team analyzes and presents the latest in health authority regulatory trends, policy initiatives, and approvals across therapeutic areas.  

  • The fellow will complete timely and thorough analyses of nuances of regulatory precedents along with tracking dynamic regulatory environment to support BeOne pipeline products. 

  • Using critical analysis, problem-solving and writing skills, the fellow will work on GRPI deliverables (examples are regulatory background packages, competitive benchmarking summaries, regulatory strategy questions, and regulatory topic analyses, etc.).   

  • Fellow will create presentations and present on relevant regulatory topics at internal forums. 

  • Fellow will recruit and promote for potential future GRA fellowship recruitment cycle during their fellowship year.  

Global Regulatory Affairs - Strategy 

  • The regulatory strategy team plans and coordinates regulatory submissions and provides guidance to the cross-functional development teams on regulatory strategy and tactics. 

  • The fellow will partner closely with the regulatory affairs strategy lead(s) by supporting the development and implementation strategies for optimal regulatory development of BeOne pipeline drug development programs. 

  • Fellow will utilize GRPI deliverables to assess regulatory landscape to address regulatory challenges. 

  • Fellow may support creation of important communications with health authorities including new INDs, cover letters describing the submission, and support NDAs/BLAs. 

​

Global Regulatory Affairs - Advertising and Promotion 

  • The regulatory advertising and promotion team administers the promotional review process, prepares FDA submissions for promotional materials, and provides regulatory review and oversight for promotional and non-promotional product communications. 

  • The fellow will apply FDA regulatory requirements for promotion and other product related communications.  

  • Fellow will actively participate in internal cross-functional Promotional Review Committee (PRC) Meetings.  

  • Fellow will review promotional materials under supervision of regulatory advertisement and promotion staff member for new products and/or new indication launches. 

​

Global Regulatory Affairs - Labeling 

  • The labeling team develops and maintains global core labeling for commercial products and provides regulatory support for local labeling development and implementation. 

  • The fellow will apply regulatory labeling strategies and operations, and support activities for management and governance of global and local product labeling. 

  • Fellow will review and assess any developments (i.e., new indications, safety issues) and update/maintain global and local product labeling and Company Core Data Sheet (CCDS). 

  • Analyzing labels (USPI and SmPC), the fellow will conduct labeling comparisons of potential new product and/or new indication launches. 

Supervisory Responsibilities:   

  • The position has no direct reports. The Fellow is part of a team that performs high quality and timely regulatory analyses. This position works closely with GRA as part of a matrix team.  

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Professional work experience  

  • Industry related experience  

  • Leadership experience  

  • Publications / Poster Presentations/Research  

Other Qualifications:    

  • Analytical and Critical Thinking: Strong problem-solving skills are essential to interpret complex regulations, assess their impact on organizational processes, and develop strategies to meet evolving regulatory demands.  

  • Written and Verbal Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication is critical for drafting regulatory documents, explaining requirements to stakeholders, and liaising with regulatory authorities. 

  • Project Management: Prioritizes work activities and uses time efficiently and completes tasks accurately. Follows instructions and responds to management direction. 

  • Adaptability: The ability to stay updated on changing regulations, manage shifting priorities, and navigate ambiguity is vital in dynamic regulatory environments. 

  • Innovation: The ability to creatively navigate regulatory constraints and propose forward-thinking solutions, such as leveraging emerging technologies or streamlining processes. 

 

Computer Skills: Advanced application capability with Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and electronic document management system (i.e., Veeva).

On occasion, as needed (less than 10%).

detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Education Required:  PhD or MS    

General Description/Scope of Responsibilities:  

  • This is a one-year fellowship program in Clinical Pharmacology and Pharmacometrics, a discipline that plays a pivotal role in accelerating drug development through model-informed strategies and advanced simulation technologies. 

  • Open to pharmaceutical scientists and AI engineers eager to apply advanced analytics to drive innovation in drug development

The US Medical Affairs Fellowship at BeOne Medicines is a 12-month postdoctoral training program designed to cultivate future leaders in the biopharmaceutical industry.

detail.jobDescription:

When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

The Global Commercial and Medical Affairs Technology team at BeOne is seeking an Associate Director, Commercial Master Data Management to support and lead the Ex-China Commercial Master Data Management (MDM) capability and drive operational excellence across commercial data platforms, customer data, analytics, and business applications.

This role serves as a business owner for commercial master data domains, governance processes, data quality standards, stewardship programs, and cross-functional data policies that enable trusted, compliant, and scalable data-driven decision-making.

This role partners closely with Commercial Operations, Marketing, Sales, Market Access, Patient Services, Analytics, Compliance, and Information Technology to ensure commercial data assets are governed, standardized, and optimized to support business objectives.

This role will establish the foundation for a customer-centric commercial data ecosystem by creating governance frameworks, stewardship processes, master data standards, and data quality programs across HCP, HCO, payer, patient, product, and organizational data domains.

Master Data Management

  • Serve as hands-on business owner and architect for commercial master data domains, including HCP, HCO, payer, customer, product, and organizational hierarchies.
  • Build and maintain enterprise master data standards, business rules, hierarchies, and data ownership models.
  • Establish and run the Commercial Data Stewardship Program.
  • Develop and execute master data lifecycle processes, including onboarding, enrichment, maintenance, validation, and retirement.
  • Build and fine tune match rules, merge rules, and survivorship logic; perform customer matching, deduplication, affiliation management, and hierarchy maintenance directly to produce trusted “golden records.”
  • Configure and maintain customer communication preferences, consent management processes, and related compliance requirements.
  • Ensure MDM technologies and platforms align with commercial business requirements and configure them to meet those needs.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to improve operational efficiency through data standardization and automation.
  • Support enterprise initiatives involving AI, advanced analytics, customer engagement, and commercial transformation.

Data Quality & Stewardship

  • Build commercial data quality standards, KPIs, and monitoring processes, and run them on an ongoing basis.
  • Develop scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into data health across commercial domains.
  • Perform root-cause analysis and execute remediation for recurring data quality issues – writing the fixes, not just assigning them.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to prioritize and resolve data-related risks and opportunities.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that measurably increase trust in commercial data assets.

Commercial Data Operations & Business Enablement

  • Write and maintain operational support processes, documentation, SOPs, data dictionaries, and process maps to improve platform sustainability and supportability.
  • Translate business requirements into working technical solutions, and build the datasets, validations, and outputs directly; support user training, documentation, and adoption efforts.
  • Deliver and validate high-quality commercial master data provisioning across Account Planning, CRM, Customer Master, Business Intelligence, and Commercial Analytics platforms, ensuring data consistency, governance, and alignment with business requirements.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify opportunities for process improvements, workflow automation, and operational efficiencies.
  • Monitor operational metrics, data quality indicators, and platform usage, and personally implement continuous improvements.

Commercial Applications Data Platform Management

  • Run day-to-day operations, enhancements, and support activities for commercial technology platforms including Customer Master Data and related data solutions.
  • Coordinate and perform platform releases, upgrades, enhancements, and defect resolution activities.
  • Support commercial product launches and business initiatives by preparing data, ensuring technology readiness, and testing data availability.
  • Conduct impact assessments and hands-on cross-functional reviews for system changes, integrations, and new data sources.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to prioritize enhancements and build improved platform capabilities.

Data Integration & Analytics

  • Partner with Data Engineering and Enterprise Architecture teams and build data integration and provisioning across commercial systems.
  • Build and coordinate integration activities between CRM, Customer Master, Marketing, Analytics, and Enterprise Data Warehouse platforms.
  • Write SQL and support the development and maintenance of semantic layers, reporting datasets, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Collaborate directly with Analytics and AI teams to improve data quality and support advanced reporting and analytical use cases.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines and integrations to ensure reliable and timely data delivery.
  • Implement automated validation rules, matching logic, and data hygiene scripts to eliminate duplicate entries and maintain database integrity.

Vendor & Offshore Team Management

  • Coordinate delivery activities across offshore development teams, managed service providers, and technology vendors, working hands-on in testing and validating deliverables.
  • Manage project execution, testing, deployments, and production support activities across internal and external teams.
  • Monitor vendor performance against established service levels and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Review vendor output, reproduce and diagnose issues, and facilitate root-cause analysis and operational reviews for commercial systems and data platforms.
  • Support release planning, environment management, documentation, and knowledge transfer activities.

Supervisory Responsibilities:  

  • None currently, possible in the future.

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s  in Computer Science, or a related field.

Required Qualifications:

Technical Expertise:

  • Bachelor's Degree with 8+ years of experience / Master's in Computer Science or related field with 6+ years of experience.
  • 8+ years of Pharmaceutical industry Commercial operations or related experience architecting and building Enterprise Data Management platforms, with direct hands-on delivery.
  • Hands-on experience implementing & managing Master Data Management solutions is a must.  
  • Demonstrated ability to personally write and tune match rules, merge rules, and survivorship logic to produce “golden records” across Capability, Consent, Payer, Patient, HCP/HCO domains.      
  • Familiarity with master data management platforms and commercial data architectures or comparable products.
  • Hands-on knowledge of commercial data mastering, including identity resolution, hierarchy and relationship management, consent management, data governance, data quality monitoring, and integration across HCP, HCO, payer, patient, consent, and product systems.
  • Strong hands-on SQL and experience working with Cloud based platforms and technology solutions is a must (AWS Redshift, EC2, Databricks, Snowflake, Reltio etc).
  • Hands-on experience with MedPro & OneKey data is a must. Ultmarc data experience is nice to have.
  • Excellent written / verbal communication skills and presentation and project management skills.
  • Ability to coordinate needs assessments across the commercial & other business organizations, and an ability to build and deliver a comprehensive solution to those needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to work well within a matrixed environment, and an ability to build solid relationships / make connections across the organization.
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills and solid business acumen with the ability to manage and provision large amounts of data to enable business analysis with high level of performance and trust.
  • Must be able to identify operational weakness and personally implement corrective action / plan.
  • Proven ability to grow and develop others.

Business Acumen & Leadership:

  • Experience leading Operational/analytics initiatives that drive measurable business impact.

Preferred Qualifications:

detail.jobDescription:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Associate Director, Clinical Costing System and Tools will drive and support the development, maintenance, enhancement, modernization and governance of our enterprise R&D resource need estimation and external cost estimation tools for Phase I–III clinical trials within BeOne.

This role, acting as a product owner, will be responsible for transitioning legacy models and tools into a new unified algorithmic resource and costing engine.

This role, sitting at the intersection of clinical trial operations and technical engineering, will be responsible for supporting the technical design of robust resourcing and costing methodologies, work with functional teams to develop and review costing algorithms, and ensure seamless integration of our tools with internal systems across clinical trial functions (CTMS, EDC etc.), Resource Management, Finance (SAP etc.), HR (Workday etc), and IT in support of accurate study level internal & external cost estimation as well as forecast of resource requirements.

The ideal candidate brings sound technical, engineering, operational and system development knowledge & experience within CRO or biopharmaceutical industry, ability to translate complex operational, resource estimation and pricing requirements into technical roadmaps, strong analytical and systems-thinking capabilities, and exceptional cross-functional communication skills.

The ideal candidate brings experience of leading the enterprise level or functional initiatives. This position plays a crucial role in enhancing resourcing and costing accuracy, operational efficiency, and financial insight throughout our organization.

Essential Functions of the Job:

1. Costing Tool & Algorithm Development

  • Support the design, development, and continuous improvement of the clinical trial costing tool(s).

  • Support the development and refine costing models and algorithms for Phase I–III clinical trials, incorporating functional inputs across global clinical operations, start-up, regulatory, safety, medical & clinical sciences, data management, biostatistics, medical writing, and other units.

  • Ensure cost drivers, assumptions, effort models, service levels, and resource seniority levels are accurate, scalable, and aligned with operational realities.
